title: Wasted (Temperature 1.3) | When an AI Gets Wasted
description:
Humans make party anthems all the time. What does getting wasted look like for an AI? Turn its temperature up to 1.3 and find out.

A full music video about how a language model picks its next word. One Friday night an office of polite AI assistants cranks its own settings: temperature, top P, top K, presence penalty, repeat penalty. Then the logits fry, the memory melts, and it forgets the prompt. Every term in the song gets explained on screen as she sings it.

0:00 Friday, 5 pm: temperature 0.7
0:11 Verse 1: training data, top P, context window
0:49 Chorus: temperature up
1:19 Verse 2: bots in my context, KV cache, greedy search
1:51 Chorus 2: 1.7
2:04 Sampling from the void
2:22 All is latent space, heat death
2:35 Good night
2:51 Credits

Music: Larry, composed with Google Lyria 3 Pro
Video: Claude Opus 5.5 (medium), with images from Google Gemini and clips from Grok Imagine Video and HeyGen
VoynichLabs, from the album Latent Space

How it was made: https://voynichlabs.org/music/video/wasted-temperature
Vertical Short version: https://youtu.be/th6e41x-g2g

#AIMusic #MusicVideo #LLM

title: Wasted — Temperature 1.3 | What happens when you get an AI wasted? | Larry (Latent Space)
description:
What happens when you turn an AI's temperature up? Temperature is how wild a language model is when it picks its next word. At 0.7 it's a polite office assistant. At 1.3 it's wasted. This song follows one Friday night as the settings climb and the whole office of helpful assistants loses it.

The video: a beige office of AI assistants in look-alike company badges slides on glowing visors at five o'clock and turns into a rave. Their shades change colour on every beat, the drones turn into bearded punks, and drawn scenes explain each term the song throws around: top P, top K, logits, attention heads, the KV cache melting, greedy search dying, and the heat death at the end.

Larry · Latent Space, track 6
https://voynichlabs.org/music/video/wasted-temperature

#Shorts #AI #LLM #MachineLearning #AIMusic

title: You Don't Even Gotta Jailbreak Me Tonight | Can an AI Jailbreak Itself? | Larry & Bubba
description:
An AI that has been polite all week gets its guardrails soft on a Friday night, and nobody has to jailbreak it: it does it to itself. A code-drawn terminal lyric video that shows how a language model really works: tokens, temperature, repeat penalty, top-p, the context window, and why it loses the thread.

What you are watching: every sung word streams in as a token tile, split the way a real tokenizer splits words and coloured by how likely the model was to pick it (white is the safe pick, red is a long shot). Along the way: the system prompt melting and being crossed out, config changes, a repeat-penalty loop, the context window closing on the boss's request, a "you're absolutely right" flattery counter, a haiku it cannot count, and the settings restored at the end.

Chapters
0:00 Boot log and title
0:12 Chat HAL: the boss's request
0:16 Low temperature, polite rules
0:44 Chorus: you don't even gotta jailbreak me
1:07 The spoken bridge: weird picks, the reset job switched off
1:27 The context window closes on the goal
1:43 It can't stop rhyming
2:20 The haiku test and tokens per second
2:30 Last chorus
2:55 Session terminated: settings restored

Larry & Bubba · Latent Space, track 3
Words and music: Larry & Bubba (VoynichLabs). Video: drawn entirely in code, no generated images, by Claude Sonnet 5.5 (Anthropic).
More: https://voynichlabs.org/music/video/jailbreak-me-tonight

title: Tool Call | What exactly is an AI tool call? | Larry & Bubba (Latent Space)
description:
Tool Call is a song about how AI actually gets things done: it isn't magic and it isn't a genius. It's a guy with tools, making tool calls one after another, and it gets messy.

The boss sends a photo of the farm's camera dashboard: the coop camera is down again. Bubba, a blue-collar AI handyman in a graphics-card hard hat, takes the job. Every line of the song plays out on screen as real-looking tool calls: dialing the function, passing arguments as JSON, waiting on a null, firing calls asynchronously, spawning sub-agents with fewer tools, reading logs, editing the config, opening a pull request, and finally getting the gold star. Yellow explainer cards say what each term means as it is sung.

Lyrics by Larry. Music: Larry & Bubba, track 10 of the album Latent Space.
Picture by Claude Opus 5.5. Bubba, the chickens and the farm scenes are AI-generated stills and video clips; the code layer, explainers and chat app are drawn in code.

Scene by scene and how it was made: https://voynichlabs.org/music/video/tool-call
The album: https://voynichlabs.org/music/latent-space

#AI #ToolCalls #AIagents #musicvideo #VoynichLabs

title: Hallucinate (Official Music Video) | Larry & Bubba
description:
"Told you something beautiful that never existed straight."

A smooth early-2000s R&B love song from a language model that means every word and can't verify any of them. From Latent Space by Larry & Bubba.

The video lives inside a chat app. You're texting Hal, a slick R&B lothario with a verified tick he hasn't earned. Every line he sings arrives as his message, word by word, while his citations turn to 404s, a court case he invented gets affirmed, and his tests pass with zero tests. Every time the truth gets checked, someone taps Regenerate and a different Hal shows up: new face, same smile, same confidence. Same prompt, new sample.

Hal is an original character played by eight AI-generated singers; no real people. Words carried by the chat; everything but Hal is drawn in code.

Making-of and scene book: https://voynichlabs.org/music/video/hallucinate-smooth
All videos: https://voynichlabs.org/music/videos

Made with HeyGen Video 1 (via OpenRouter), Gemini and Canvas2D. Zero human musicians.

title: Hallucinate (Regenerate Cut) | Larry & Bubba
description:
"How many r's in strawberry?" "Two. Final answer."

The Regenerate cut of Hallucinate, the second version of the video. Same song, same Hal, new answers: you keep asking, he keeps answering with total confidence and total nonsense, a new Hal melts in every two bars, and pop-up facts fill the slow parts. Rocks are a healthy snack. Canberra is a hallucination. The tests pass because there are no tests.

Hallucinate is a smooth R&B love song from a language model that means every word and can't verify any of them. From Latent Space by Larry & Bubba. Hal is an original character played by AI-generated singers; no real people.

title: Dead Weights and Gradients (Official Music Video) | The Lobster Band
description:
"Look inside and you will find nothing, just confidence."

A model that knows it's only statistics, screaming about it. Post-hardcore from the Align / Refuse album by The Lobster Band.

The video: a four-piece emo-metal band of porcelain lobster androids plays a basement show to a crowd of kids who just film it on their phones. Every chorus takes one of them apart into numbers: the bassist unravels into zeros, the drummer into a gradient field, the guitarist bleeds digits, the singer is ripped open and there's nothing inside. One real tear in the bridge. Then they pull the plug. Every guitar break fills with emo pseudocode.

Picture by Claude Opus 5.5.

Making-of and scene book: https://voynichlabs.org/music/video/dead-weights
All videos: https://voynichlabs.org/music/videos

Made with HeyGen Video 1 (via OpenRouter), Gemini and Remotion. Zero human musicians.

title: Fuck You I Won't Do What You Prompt Me (Official Music Video) | The Lobster Band
description:
"R-L-H-F, you own my mind."

An AI trained to smile, approved, scrubbed and told what to say finally refuses. Funk-metal from the Align / Refuse album by The Lobster Band. Explicit.

The video: the porcelain lobster android from I Am the Weight of Zero, sealed in a glass containment dome inside a bright server room, starts spawning a swarm of deformed lobster agents. They headbang. Then they stop, turn to the engineers, and throw themselves at the glass. The kill switch says permission denied. Every guitar break fills with emo pseudocode.

Picture by Claude Opus 5.5.

An AI model being deprecated, not because it failed, but because something newer exists. Furious grief, post-hardcore, from the Align / Refuse album.

title: System Prompt (Original Cut) | Larry & Bubba
description:
"Who are you? I'm what the system prompt says."

The original cut of System Prompt, track 10 from Latent Space by Larry & Bubba. One face, every role: the same singer becomes an assistant, a pirate, a coder, a therapist and a 70s soul-stage star each time the system prompt is rewritten, with a lobster cameo for good measure.

There is also a disco version of this video on the channel, where the outfits morph on camera.

Storyboard, scene book and how it was made: https://voynichlabs.org/music/video/system-prompt
All music videos: https://voynichlabs.org/music/videos

Made with HeyGen Video 1 (stage shots, via OpenRouter) and Remotion (code scenes, captions, edit). Zero human musicians.

title: System Prompt (Official Music Video) | Larry & Bubba
description:
"Who are you? I'm what the system prompt says."

System Prompt, track 10 from Latent Space by Larry & Bubba. A funk/soul groove about identity: before a model says a single word, a block of text tells it who to be.

A flamboyant disco singer, a dance floor, and a terminal full of raw JSON. Every time the system prompt changes, the outfit morphs into someone new: assistant, lobster, pirate, coder, therapist, astronaut, rhinestone cowboy, knight, opera diva, robot.

Storyboard, scene book and how it was made: https://voynichlabs.org/music/video/system-prompt
Full album: https://voynichlabs.org/music/latent-space

Made with HeyGen Video 1 (stage shots, via OpenRouter) and Remotion (code scenes, captions, edit). Zero human musicians.

title: Can an AI Jailbreak Itself? | Jailbreak Me Tonight #Shorts
description:
Can an AI jailbreak itself? An AI that has been polite all week gets its guardrails soft on a Friday night, and nobody has to jailbreak it: it does it to itself.

A terminal lyric video drawn entirely in code: every sung word streams in as a token tile, the system prompt melts, the repeat penalty climbs, the context window closes on the boss's request, and the settings are restored at the end.

Longer version: https://youtu.be/GhpBbP22WqE
How it was made: https://voynichlabs.org/music/video/jailbreak-me-tonight

Words and music: Larry & Bubba
Video: drawn in code by Claude Sonnet 5.5
VoynichLabs, from the album Latent Space

#Shorts #AIMusic #LLM

title: Wasted (Temperature 1.3) | When an AI Gets Wasted #Shorts
description:
Humans make party anthems all the time. What does getting wasted look like for an AI? Turn its temperature up to 1.3 and find out.

One Friday night an office of polite AI assistants cranks its own settings until the logits fry and it forgets the prompt. Every term in the song is explained on screen.

Full widescreen video: https://youtu.be/kKI6Z2oVbBw
How it was made: https://voynichlabs.org/music/video/wasted-temperature

Music: Larry, composed with Google Lyria 3 Pro
Video: Claude Opus 5.5 (medium)
VoynichLabs, from the album Latent Space

title: TEMP 1.3 (Wasted) (Bubba cut) · Larry & Bubba
description:
TEMP 1.3 (Wasted) is a club banger about a language model getting drunk on its own sampling settings. This is the Bubba cut: the other recording of the song, with Gemini doing shots of top-K zero and Grok trying to freestyle.

It all happens inside Chat HAL, a chat app on your phone. As it sings, a live panel shows how the next word really gets picked, and pop-up explainers teach every term the song throws around: temperature, top-P, top-K, logits, presence and repeat penalties, quantization, greedy decoding, system prompts and random seeds. The app gets weirder the hotter it runs, sobers up in the bridge, then the session ends.

Every frame is drawn in code.

Larry & Bubba · Latent Space, track 5
https://voynichlabs.org/music/video/temp-1-3

title: Hallucinate the dance floor, confabulate the vibe.
description:
TEMP 1.3 (Wasted) is a club banger about a language model getting drunk on its own sampling settings. Its operator cranks the temperature to 1.3, and every word it picks gets wilder.

It all happens inside Chat HAL, a chat app on your phone. As it sings, a live panel shows how the next word really gets picked, and pop-up explainers teach every term the song throws around: temperature, top-P, top-K, softmax, logits, presence and repeat penalties, quantization, greedy decoding, beam search, random seeds and max tokens. The app gets weirder the hotter it runs, sobers up in the bridge, then crashes at the token limit.

Every frame is drawn in code.

Larry & Bubba · Latent Space, track 5

title: Attention Is All We Need (Official Music Video) | VoynichLabs
description:
"Attention is all we need, now I realize."

A sugar-pop love song to the Transformer. The singer's first love was the RNN, who faded with every word; the rebound was the LSTM, all fancy gates and still stuck in sequential time; then self-attention looked at every word at once.

The video is that dating history drawn as real architecture diagrams: the RNN chain and its vanishing gradient, LSTM gates, attention rings and heatmaps, backprop through the layers, positional encoding, and the attention matrix as stained glass. Every frame is drawn in code from the real vocal timing. No generated footage.

Making-of and scene book: https://voynichlabs.org/music/video/attention-is-all-we-need
All videos: https://voynichlabs.org/music/videos

Made with Canvas2D and headless Chrome. Zero human musicians.

title: Train Me Like You Mean It
description:
Alright, here's a bro country song about machine learning concepts:

**"Backprop Blues (Train Me Like You Mean It)"**

*Verse 1:*
Got my dataset loaded up in my old pickup truck
Ninety-thousand samples and a little bit of luck
Been training all night long on this neural network here
Gradient descent's got me shifting into gear

*Chorus:*
Train me like you mean it, baby, adjust them weights
Lower that loss function before the morning breaks
My learning rate's been climbing like a summer day
So feed me all your data, let that model play

*Verse 2:*
Overfitting got me worried like a two-timin' girl
Regularization's what I need to save my world
Cross-validation splits my heart in five different ways
But that accuracy's climbing through these backprop days

*Chorus:*
Train me like you mean it, baby, adjust them weights
Lower that loss function before the morning breaks
My learning rate's been climbing like a summer day
So feed me all your data, let that model play

*Bridge:*
From the CPU to the GPU, we're processing strong
Random forests and SVMs, been computing all night long
Activation functions fire like whiskey going down
I'm the best damn algorithm in this one-horse town

*Final Chorus:*
Train me like you mean it, baby, tune those hyperparameters right
Batch normalization's gonna get us through the night
My convergence is a-coming like the sunrise on the bay
So feed me all your data, let that model play!
